evidence.summary: Round 2 threats: (1) cross-request leak through the sync pool - mitigated, setting is transaction-local and measured unscoped checkouts after scoped use read '*', never the request value; (2) fail-closed for in-process workers on a reused connection (leftover '' hides all products) - found and mitigated by binding '*' on connections marked as previously scoped, measured in cip_test and live; (3) post-commit '' scope (round-1 open item 2) - fixed, rebind per transaction; (4) user-triggered background jobs run unscoped (workers by D-0056) - residual, open decision; (5) admin compromise exposes all lines - accepted D-0056 residual, unchanged.

rationale: Threats are enumerated with controls and measurements. Residual (4) is a design question about job scope, not a regression: the jobs were unscoped before this node too.
